description: This file defines components and functions related to password block options in a code editor, including generating password options based on user query and retrieving existing password blocks.

methods.name: GetPasswordBlockOption
methods.description: Creates and returns a BlockPickerOption for the password block based on the current editor state.

methods.name: GetDynamicPasswordBlocks
methods.description: Generates password block options dynamically based on a query string input; for example, creating a password of specified length if it meets minimum length requirements.
